author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
description: Tactical combat states, grid movement modifiers, and aura states from LeTBS

states.name: Paralyze
states.description: The unit is paralyzed by kinetic or electrical shock, skipping their active turn.

states.name: Intimidating Aura
states.description: Vanguard presence radiating kinetic threat. Adjacent enemies suffer -15% ATK; wielder gains 70% counter-attack chance.

states.name: Heavy Strike
states.description: Target is staggered by a crushing blow, reducing grid movement points by 3.

states.name: Focused
states.description: Forces enemy combatants to focus offensive actions upon the vanguard.

states.name: Light Steps
states.description: Grants agility and unencumbered stride, increasing grid movement budget by +1 point.

states.name: Ghost Arrow
states.description: An ethereal spectral arrow anchors the target's shadow, reducing movement points by 1.

states.name: Burning
states.description: Target or grid tile is enveloped in flames. Damages occupants and spreads to adjacent flammable tiles.

states.name: Tactical Ambush Advantage
states.description: Initiated by spending TP to ambush foes from the tactical overworld. Grants +20% ATK, first strike priority, and starts the turn battle with 50% staggered enemy poise.

states.name: Tactical Disadvantage
states.description: Triggered when overworld TP is depleted or caught unawares. Unit suffers -15% ATK, -10% Evasion, and enemies strike first in the action battle transition.

states.name: Celerity Surge
states.description: Tactical TP reserve fuels a rapid burst of speed. AGI (Celerity) +25%, accelerating action gauges in side-scroll combat.

states.name: Fortune's Blessing
states.description: Astute tactical scouting unlocks astral favor. LUK (Fortune) +30%, critical strike chance +20%, and increased battle loot yield.

states.name: Tactical Pinning
states.description: Zone-of-Control lockup. Unit is pinned on the tactical grid, unable to expend TP for traversal, and suffers -20% Bastion DEF in turn combat.

states.name: Tactical Exhaustion
states.description: Exhaustion resulting from depleted TP (<10). Grid movement costs double and spellcasting consumes 20% additional MP.
